purpose: An approval is the owner's Touch ID over exact bytes. A second caller, a copied literal or a loosened gate lets an agent approve its own effect without the owner noticing.
requirement: Signing has one owner: board_model::effect builds the statements and names the namespaces, and board_plugin::sign runs the signer and ssh-keygen. Only board-ops's effects module calls sign, verify, Effect::approval or Effect::owner_write, and only the owners lint.toml lists name a signing literal. A released vector is never edited; a changed layout is a new vectors/signing version.
